title: Evaluate the hydraulic interpretation using explicit comparative testing
rationale: The next research step should test whether the proposed hydraulic analogy explains textual and comparative observations better than plausible non-hydraulic alternatives.
alternatives_considered: Treat the Genesis sequence as a purely literary ordering without hydraulic analogy.
Treat water imagery as cosmological symbolism without engineering correspondence.
selected_action: Conduct a structured comparison of predicted hydraulic functions, textual observations, and counterevidence.
notes: This decision authorizes testing; it does not establish the hypothesis as true.
